summary: Completed full-stack testing of Family Organizer app. Backend: 33/33 pytest tests pass (auth, family, events, shopping, notes, frequent items, barcode lookup via Open Food Facts, family-scoped isolation). Frontend: Login page, Dashboard with all 5 bento cards (Calendar, Shopping, Weekend, Notes, Family), add-event, add-shopping-item, toggle, add-note, add-child, barcode manual scanner all working. Authentication works via both Bearer token and cookie.

issues: Missing `aria-describedby` / DialogDescription on Radix DialogContent — accessibility warning in console (non-blocking). Add <DialogDescription> to AddEventDialog / AddChildDialog / AddNoteDialog / BarcodeScannerDialog.

action_items: Optional: Add DialogDescription components to all Radix dialogs to remove a11y console warnings (low priority, non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: HTTPOnly cookie is set (good) but frontend also stores session_token in localStorage via AuthCallback — acceptable fallback for third-party cookie blocking, but document the dual-auth approach clearly.
server.py: /api/shopping/barcode/{barcode} calls Open Food Facts without caching — consider adding a small TTL cache to avoid repeated external calls for the same barcode.
server.py line 236-237: Unused `for p in parents: if isinstance(p.get('created_at'), str): pass` dead code — should be removed.
server.py line 490: `@app.on_event('shutdown')` is deprecated in FastAPI 0.93+. Use lifespan context manager.
server.py: No index on user_sessions.session_token — add index for O(log n) token lookup under load.

server.py: family_id is generated per-user; no flow to invite/join another parent to the same family_id yet (both mum and dad would currently get separate families on first login). This may be out of MVP scope but should be noted — currently only added children are truly shared; a second Google SSO would create a new family_id.
Frontend: AuthContext / AuthCallback files not reviewed in depth but integration works; confirm session_id URL fragment is stripped after exchange for cleanliness.
test_credentials: SESSION_TOKEN=test_session_1776655943013, USER_ID=test-user-1776655943013, FAMILY_ID=family-1776655943013 — seeded directly in MongoDB (test_database) via mongosh because real auth flows through Emergent Google OAuth.
seed_data_creation: Seeded test user + session in MongoDB (test_database) via mongosh. All TEST_-prefixed records cleaned up post-test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py covers all 33 scenarios. Reuse SESSION_TOKEN from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. For UI testing, seed the session via page.context.add_cookies + localStorage (see script in this iteration). Note: calendar view defaults to current month — use current/next month dates in test events or click next-month button to verify visibility. Multi-family isolation via separate Google accounts is not directly testable without a second OAuth flow; currently only tested via 401 on invalid token.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. One test assertion failure (Calendar UI: 'Event not found in calendar') was a test-script flaw — event was created with date 2026-03-15 while calendar view was April 2026, so not visible in the rendered grid. API verification confirmed event persisted correctly (GET /api/events returned the created event).
